slides.title: Value Is Realized After the Congress, Not During It
bullets: Commitments, relationships, and insights become real value in the weeks after
Follow-up is the least visible but most decisive phase of the whole cycle
It's also the phase most often neglected under pressure to return to normal work

slides.title: Deliver on Every Commitment You Made
bullets: Send that article, make that introduction, share that study information
Do it within a short, reasonable window, ideally the first few days
Fast, precise follow-through consolidates the trust just built
Late or generic follow-through can undo much of the relational value

slides.title: Update the CRM Systematically
bullets: Log every relevant interaction held during the congress
Update each KOL or DOL's profile and relationship level
Schedule the next cultivation steps per the Module 3 engagement plan
Don't let the contact go cold until the next casual interaction

slides.title: Turn Insights Into Action
bullets: Prioritized insights from the debrief can't just sit in a filed document
Actively communicate them to evidence generation, strategy, and HEOR teams
Track explicitly whether they were incorporated into any decision or plan
That closes the loop between capturing an insight and actually using it

slides.title: Evaluate the Congress Against Its Own Objectives
bullets: Honestly review whether the planned success indicators were met
Qualified interactions, insights captured, key session coverage
Identify what worked and what could improve next time
Document those lessons so next year's planning starts from a stronger base

slides.title: Follow-Up Sustains What the Congress Built
bullets: A congress without rigorous follow-up wastes much of its investment
Disciplined follow-up turns a one-time event into value sustained all year

takeaway.title: Follow-up is what converts a congress from a moment into lasting strategic value
bullets: Fast, precise delivery on commitments protects the trust you built
CRM updates and insight follow-through close the loop on the event
Honest evaluation against original objectives improves every future congress
